response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, s.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Stations whose telescopes all have NULL bandusagepct have no average and are excluded from both the overall mean and the results.
